title: The Body of Christ
definition: The Body of Christ is the biblical picture of believers being united together under Christ as one spiritual body.
summary: Every believer has value and purpose in the body. No member is unnecessary, and all are called to serve in love.
christFocus: Christ is the Head, and every believer is a member of His body with a place and purpose.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Every believer has value and purpose in the body. No member is unnecessary, and all are called to serve in love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
